title: Gov Tracker Census
description: Who else does a government homepage contact? Compare observed requests, scripts and cookies across a fixed public website sample.

data_info.detail: A fixed set of 15 federal, British Columbia and Nova Scotia homepages is visited in a fresh Chromium context, with no consent choices, login or other interaction. Robots restrictions and navigation failures remain explicit. This is a homepage sample, not a census of every government website.
